title: Apache Answer
name: apache-answer
description: Question-and-answer site for a community, product forum or team knowledge base, with voting, accepted answers, tags, reputation and badges. Source: https://github.com/apache/answer

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London. The site starts on it, and you can change it later in the admin.

note: Open http://<your-host>:9080 from the address you'll actually use, since the setup wizard saves it as the Site URL that links and uploads are built from. On the database step pick SQLite (it defaults to MySQL, which isn't there) and leave the file as /data/answer.db. The last step creates the admin, and whoever reaches the wizard first gets to, so do it straight away. Sign-ups stay open but need email verification, so new accounts can't post until you set up Admin --> Advanced --> SMTP, or close them under Advanced --> Login. The database, config and uploads all live in the volume. Docs: answer.apache.org/docs
